card.name: Digits inside numeric ranges and tiers
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points or percent signs partway through a number in a range or dose-tier table, often the upper end of 'X to Y'. Also category words like Mild in renal-function bands.

modes.label: Numbers in range tables
modes.description: Final or middle digit of a number in a dose, weight or concentration range.

modes.label: Range endpoints with units
modes.description: Percent sign or digit closing a range of values.
modes.example: in the general range of 25% to 60<<%>> of maximum intensity

modes.label: Severity band labels
modes.description: Severity word in a kidney-function or grade band list.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of numbers in ranges and tier tables, such as dose bands or kidney function categories.
